band.title: Find AI glasses in the exam room with the invigilator's phone
band.desc: ExamScan watches the signals of AI glasses, wireless earbuds, smartwatches and phones in the exam room with just the invigilator's phone. No equipment to install, and records stay on the phone.
hero.badge: NEW · On Google Play in December 2026
hero.title:
AI glasses cheating?
One invigilator phone keeps watch
hero.sub: ExamScan is an app for invigilators in the exam room. Using Bluetooth and Wi-Fi signals it finds AI glasses, wireless earbuds, smartwatches, phones and hotspots, vibrates when a new device appears, and helps you walk to the seat.
hero.note: The app for individual invigilators launches on Google Play in December. Schools, education offices and exam bodies can apply for a pilot before launch.
problem.label: WHY NOW
problem.title: Cheating tools in the exam room have changed
problem.lead: AI glasses with a camera and microphone look like ordinary glasses, and wireless earbuds and smartwatches are too small to spot by eye.
problem.c1.t: You can't tell them apart by eye
problem.c1.d: AI glasses look almost the same as regular glasses. Walking around the room only goes so far.
problem.c2.t: Equipment is costly and heavy to run
problem.c2.d: Radio detectors cost money per unit and need to be placed and managed in every exam room.
problem.c3.d: You need a record of when, where and how a suspicious situation was checked, to explain it later.
how.label: HOW IT WORKS
how.title: Three steps with one invigilator phone
how.s1.d: Before the exam, take one look around the room to find suspicious devices early. Devices in the hallway or next room and classroom equipment are set aside.
how.s2.d: During the exam the screen just shows “All clear”. When a new wireless device appears, the phone vibrates and shows its type and distance (near, medium, far).
how.s3.d: Follow the signal bars and vibration to the seat. Where it was found and what was done is kept as a record that can't be edited, and can be exported as a PDF report.
shots.title: Real screens
detect.label: HONEST LIMITS
detect.title: What it can and can't catch
detect.lead: ExamScan gives you a signal that needs checking, not a verdict. The invigilator makes the final call.
detect.yes.title: What it can watch
detect.yes.1: AI glasses (smart glasses with Bluetooth on, such as Meta Ray-Ban)
detect.yes.2: Wireless earbuds (waiting to connect or advertising)
detect.no.title: Hard or impossible to catch
detect.no.1: Locked phones (they send almost no signal)
detect.no.2: Cheap earbuds that are already connected (no advertising signal)
record.label: RECORDS & PRIVACY
record.title: Keeps a record, not personal data
record.1.t: Exam records that can't be edited
record.1.d: The original is never changed; later judgments are only appended as dated review notes.
record.2.d: Export the timeline, where devices were found and what was done as a PDF, and replay how the exam went.
record.3.d: Nothing is sent to a server. No ad or analytics SDKs, and you choose how long records are kept.
record.4.d: Only seat or exam numbers are written down. Sharing is done by the invigilator under school rules.

price.title: Pricing
price.personal.d: Pay once on Google Play, no subscription; the price is shown in your currency. Try 3 exams and 3 pre-exam checks free first. (Launches in December)
price.org.d: We send a quote and pilot plan based on the number of devices and your exam dates. Applications before launch are welcome.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.1.q: Do we need any extra equipment?
faq.1.a: No. The invigilator's Android phone is enough. It only uses Bluetooth and location permission (Android requires it to read signal strength).
faq.2.q: Does it collect students' personal data?
faq.2.a: No. Records are stored only on the invigilator's phone and are never sent to our servers. Seat or exam numbers are used instead of student names.
faq.3.a: No. Devices that send almost no signal, such as locked phones or cheap earbuds that are already connected, are hard to catch. We state these limits up front, in the app and on this page. ExamScan helps invigilation; it is not a judging device.
faq.4.q: How does an institution pilot work?
faq.4.a: Tell us your institution, the number of devices and your exam dates with the form below, and we will email you how a pilot works and a quote.
